title: thalictrum simplex subsp. dubium
intro: Thalictrum simplex subsp. dubium, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a perennial plant species within the Ranunculaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Thalictrum simplex subsp. dubium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
